evidence.excerpt: To bridge this gap, we introduce Humanity's Sixth Sense (HSS), a benchmark for intuitive visual reasoning.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Despite excelling in many complex tasks that require advanced perception and knowledge, current models still struggle significantly on these visual tasks that are intuitive for humans.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Frontier MLLMs fall short of human performance: participants reach 93.1% accuracy, while the strongest model, GPT-6-astra, reaches only 53.6% even at maximum reasoning effort.
